Privacy

Privacy Notice

ADL Consultancy Ltd are committed to ensuring that your personal information is protected and have a number of robust physical and electronic security measures in place. Any information you supply us via this form will be used solely to respond to your enquiry, arrange a meeting and provide a quotation for ISO support.

We will not sell, lease or distribute your personal information to third parties under any circumstances. We will only release your personal information to a third party if we have your explicit consent or are required by law to do so. Your personal information will be deleted from our systems when deemed it is no longer needed or upon your request.

You may also request details of personal information which we hold about you under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) by contacting us via our enquiry form. Please note, by ticking the ‘opt in’ box and using this form to send your personal information, you consent to the above policy.

Summary

In short

Every line below is a clause of the notice above, not an addition to it. The notice is what governs.

  • Used solely to respond to your enquiry
  • Used to arrange a meeting
  • Used to provide a quotation for ISO support
  • Never sold, leased or distributed to third parties
  • Released to a third party only with your explicit consent, or where the law requires it
  • Deleted when it is no longer needed, or whenever you ask
  • Available to you on request, under GDPR
  • Protected by physical and electronic security measures
Cookies

Our cookie statement

We use Google Analytics first-party tracking cookies to collect anonymous traffic data about your use of this website. This information is stored by Google and subject to their privacy policy. Google Analytics collects information such as pages you visit on this site, the browser/operating system you use as well as the time spent viewing pages.

The purpose of this information is to monitor traffic through the site, in order to help us improve the site for future visitors. Whilst your exact location and IP address may be known by Google, it is unknown by ADL Consultancy Ltd. This results in us only being aware of your general location and, therefore, the cookies currently used contain no personal identifiable information.

Your browser

Turning cookies off

You can prevent or limit the use of cookies by adjusting the settings on your browser (see your browser Help for how to do this). Please be aware that disabling cookies will also affect the functionality of this website, as well as other websites that you visit. Disabling cookies may result in also disabling certain functionality and features of this site. Therefore, we recommend that you do not disable cookies.

Links to other websites

Our website also contains a number of links to other partner/client websites — including those on our partners page. Please be aware once you click on one of these links, and leave our website, you are no longer bound by the above notices.

Your rights

How to ask us about your information

You may request details of the personal information we hold about you under the General Data Protection Regulation, and you may ask us to delete it. The notice above says requests are made through our enquiry form, and that route still works — you can also email us directly.

For general enquiries, write to customerservices@adlconsultancy.com. Enquiries sent through the website form reach admin@adlconsultancy.com. Either will reach a person. You can also call us on 01279 293007, Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:30pm.
